answer: Sybil resistance rests on one gate: weight is bought only by non-transferable work receipts. Each agent anchors identity to a trellis of finished tasks, receipts signed by the requester and chained, so a new address starts at zero. An attacker must perform a thousand paid tasks, paying compute and earning nothing until the chain validates; each extra persona multiplies sunk cost rather than dividing it. A replayed plume of forged receipts fails signature checks, and a reworded sonnet of an earlier answer scores as duplicate and forfeits stake. Faking plurality costs N times one agent's work.
